description: Land Acquisition - Weliwatta, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire 35 specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, assessments, and claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters including land acquisitions.
